chunks: Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Ubaydah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
He was asked about a paternal cousin and a grandfather. He said: “The property belongs to the grandfather.”
ai.seo_question: Who inherits when the deceased leaves a paternal cousin and a grandfather?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in inheritance: when the heirs under consideration are a paternal cousin and a grandfather, the estate goes to the grandfather. It reflects the jurisprudential treatment of nearer paternal relatives having priority in succession.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5646 - Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Riʾab from Abu Ubaydah from Abu Jafar (as) who was asked about a paternal cousin and a grandfather (regarding inheritance).
Imam (as) said: "The entire inheritance belongs to the grandfather."
